settings.heading: Everything we hold, and why.
settings.intro: We collect four things. Each has a reason, a lifespan and a switch. We have never sold data, and the company is structured so that we cannot.
settings.cta_heading: Exercise any of these in one message.
settings.cta_text: Our data steward answers within one working day — no forms, no ticket numbers. Write to privacy@oroskin.com, or ask the concierge to pass it on.
